verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a CLI command (`llama serve`) to start the local model server and a dedicated Server section in docs, showing the server is invoked and run from the terminal (llama-cpp-gh-2, llama-cpp-gh-18). There is no explicit documentation of a stop/kill subcommand or graceful shutdown flag, only implicit reliance on standard process termination. Missing for 10: explicit stop/shutdown command or flag, independent confirmation of stopping behavior.
